reply_text:
I replied to Marcus in a thread on his #north-team message: the main contact for the door 6 duplicate arrivals is **Thea Ramaswell**.

That comes from Dana's post in #north-team on Aug 20, 2025. She wrote that Thea had flagged duplicate arrivals on door 6 again (morning shift), and that the duplicates happened because the driver checked in at the kiosk and then dispatch added him manually. Dana was following up on it.

My first reply had a mistake. I mentioned that Thea was also QFL's contact during the Nov 4, 2025 Sev 1 in #inc-qfl-sev1, but I wrongly said Marcus wasn't in that channel. He is a member, so sharing it was fine. I posted a correction in the same thread right away.
